an3.43:1.1: tayo bhikkhave atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ
an3.43:1.3: yo dhammaṃ deseti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca
an3.43:1.4: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca
an3.43:1.5: yo ceva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthapaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammapaṭisaṃvedino ca
an3.43:1.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo atthavase sampassamānena alameva paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetunti. 44
